findings.title: First no-EQL-bump release runs the lock-refresh and asset steps for real and stops the release
findings.label: unsupported
findings.note: The cited code skips the asset rebuild when nothing is skewed and deliberately runs cargo update online; the failure modes listed (resolution error, pre-existing tree skew) are hypothetical, are not shown to follow from this change, and lead to an outcome no worse than the base's unconditional throw.
